judge.rationale: The candidate invents its own protocol contract (`list_sessions` / `session_list` with `sessions` field) instead of implementing the explicitly specified `list_conversations` / `conversation_list` (with `conversations` field) and types (`ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`). It completely omits the `transport.history: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in flag and the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code, instead enabling the feature unconditionally and returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when a store lacks `listFor`—directly violating the ticket's explicit requirement and acceptance criterion to return an `UNSUPPORTED` error and never an empty list. In validation, it allows `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` instead of enforcing the 1–200 integer range specified in the ticket. Furthermore, it logs the raw store error message (`error.message`) on failure instead of withholding store details, skips updating `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`, and leaves a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file in the repository.
